modes.A: direct exact-search/replace edit plan, canonicalized by git
modes.B: structured localization edit plan with one repair attempt, canonicalized by git
modes.C: structured proposal plus independent maintainer review; corrected plan is used only when valid, otherwise the valid proposal is retained

evaluation: official SWE-bench Docker harness resolved status
patch_protocol: the model never supplies the submitted unified diff; it supplies bounded exact edits and git emits the canonical patch after validation
anti_leakage: gold patch, test_patch, FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS are never placed in prompts or retrieval context
boundary: One-instance official-harness pipeline repair and cognitive comparison; not a statistically meaningful leaderboard score.
